symptom: `create microflow M.F ($B: Boolean) returns Boolean as $R begin if $B then return true; end if; end;` passed `mxcli check` and `exec`, then MxBuild reported CE0109 "Undefined variable 'R'" at the End event. Same in a nanoflow.
file: mdl/executor/validate_return_variable_defined.go checkReturnVariableDefined (MDL097), called from validate_microflow.go validate() after the MDL003 block and from validate_nanoflow.go. Test: mdl/executor/validate_return_variable_defined_test.go
cause: MDL003 (missing return on a non-void flow) exempts `returns T as $R`, on the reasoning that the End event returns $R whether or not the body writes a RETURN. That is true only while $R has a value where the flow ends; an undefined $R is CE0109 and one defined only inside a branch or loop is CE0108.
insight: **An exemption written from one measured case is a rule with an unstated precondition; re-measure the boundary before widening or narrowing it.** The 11.13.0 measurement behind the AS-clause exemption had $R assigned, so it held; the parity fixture left $R undefined. Measured on 11.16.1, one `mx check -j`, 15 flows microflow and nanoflow: undefined + a path off the end = CE0109; defined only in a nested body = CE0108; declared at the top level = clean whether or not the body falls off the end (even declared AFTER an if that returns); undefined but every path returns = clean; no AS clause = CE0067 (MDL003, unchanged). So the rule is about where $R is defined, not about return statements. Guarded by both bodyReturns and lastStmtIsReturn so a named join or raise error stays quiet. Sweep of every .mdl in the repo (1658 flows, 684 with an AS clause): 2 hits, both correct: the f07 fixture and bug-tests/captrack-19-return-in-loop-as-clause.fail.mdl, whose own header independently records the same CE0109 for an unassigned $Done. A third hit came from the skill-example gate, not the sweep: docs-site/src/tutorial/skills.md:83 showed `returns Boolean as $result` with an empty body, which fails the build; fixed there. Control: stubbing the check fails the five positive cases and the @excluded test.
